title: August 17, 2026
body:
This serverless compute release includes updates from [Databricks Runtime 19](/aws/en/release-notes/runtime/19).

#### New features

* **`is_valid_variant` function**: The `is_valid_variant` function returns `true` if the input is a well-formed `VARIANT` value and `false` otherwise. Use it to validate variant data before downstream processing.
* **`DataFrameGroupBy.cov` and `SeriesGroupBy.describe` in pandas API on Spark**: The pandas API on Spark now supports `DataFrameGroupBy.cov`, which computes the pairwise covariance of columns within each group, and `SeriesGroupBy.describe`, which generates descriptive statistics for each group.
* **`pa.ChunkedArray` support in `createDataFrame`**: `createDataFrame()` now handles pandas DataFrames with PyArrow `ChunkedArray` columns, preventing type errors when you use Arrow-backed pandas data.
